title: Consent score propagation and query-time redaction pipeline
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Build a pipeline that propagates per-user consent scores to analytics materialized views and implements query-time redaction for sensitive fields so we can enforce opt-outs and data minimization without expensive backfills. This covers ingestion tagging, downstream join propagation, and a lightweight runtime redaction layer in the Console query service.
comments: 2025-02-12 Alyssa Chen: RFC posted in Confluence (https://confluence.redwood/CONSENT-PROP) describing consent score schema, decay rules, and propagation semantics. Seeking feedback from PM and security on retention windows.
